✦ Where it all began ✦

The day I finally met you

After all the waiting, all the calls, all the dreams — you were finally standing in front of me. In Chandigarh. Real. Here.

The Very First Moment

The First Hello

After everything — all the conversations, all the waiting — you finally stood in front of me. Real. Here. And for a second, the whole world just went quiet.

That First Hug

Like a scene from a film

When we hugged, it felt like a scene from our own love story. Warm, real, and full of everything we hadn't said yet. Like Nikhil and Roop's story had just written its very first page.

A Quiet Moment

Holding your hand

When I held your hand for the first time, something inside me went quiet — in the best way. Like a piece of me had finally, gently, found exactly where it belonged.

Our Happy Place

The Café

We found a café with warm light and a sign that said what we were both feeling. We sat together, hands intertwined, and I didn't want that afternoon to ever end.

Wandering Together

We walked through Chandigarh — your hand in mine, you showing me things you liked, both of us laughing. I was just so happy to exist right beside you.

We went to Gurudwara Sahib Ji Patshahi Dasvin together. Bowing our heads side by side, hands folded. I felt Waheguru's blessing on us both. So deeply grateful.

✦ The most sacred moment ✦

We bowed our heads together

🙏

Gurudwara Sahib Ji Patshahi Dasvin

Chandigarh · 6th June 2026
ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਦਸਵੀਂ

Of everything that day gave us — the first hug, the held hands, the café, the laughter — this moment was perhaps the most sacred and beautiful of all.

We walked in together. Side by side. Heads bowed, hands folded, hearts full. I felt something bigger than words — like Waheguru was watching over us, like we were exactly where we were supposed to be.

I felt so blessed. Not just to be there — but to be there with you beside me. Carrying each other in our hearts at the same sacred moment. That is something I will hold forever.

"I didn't just feel love that day. I felt gratitude — for you, for us, for every road that led me right here." 🙏

Morning · Mansar Café

Our first morning coffee

Sitting Together

Holding your hand over coffee

The Farewell

✦ From my heart ✦

A letter for you, Roop

To my love, Roop —

I don't know how to explain what those two days meant to me. June 6th and 7th were just dates on a calendar — until they became the days everything changed.

When I hugged you for the first time, I understood why people write love songs. When I held your hand, I understood why people talk about feeling complete. You did that — in one city, in one afternoon, you made me feel whole.

And the Gurudwara — Roop, I will carry that moment forever. Walking in beside you, bowing our heads together at Patshahi Dasvin, feeling Waheguru's grace around us — I felt so blessed. Not just to be there. But to be there with you.

And then that morning at Mansar — your smile over two coffees, your hand in mine, the quiet of a morning that asked for nothing but us — that is the morning I want every day for the rest of my life.

When I hugged you goodbye, I held on a little longer. Not because I was sad — but because I knew this wasn't an ending. This was just the beginning of our story.

Forever yours, Nikhil 🌹
